seoTitle: CSAT Score Calculator: Customer Satisfaction Percentage
metaDescription: Compute CSAT from the number of responses at each rating from 1 to 5, with satisfied share and average rating. Free and private.
intro: Enter response counts per rating and get the CSAT percentage and the average.
why:
CSAT is the share of responses that are satisfied. Teams differ on whether satisfied means 4 and 5 or only 5, so the cutoff is a choice here.

Always state the cutoff when reporting CSAT. The bars show the distribution, which often says more than the single number.
howTo: Enter how many responses gave each rating.
Compare periods with the same cutoff.

faq.a: Satisfied responses divided by all responses, times 100.
Both are used; 4 and 5 is common.
